spec.description:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle Peak combines the sculptural 3D angled peak profile
of Lanes with high-definition digital UV printing. Available in realistic timber
grains (Acoustic Timber) and textured stone finishes, it replicates heavy
architectural materials without the weight, cost, or fire hazards. Its
integrated rear air gap delivers enhanced low-frequency sound absorption
(NRC 0.80), while its glue-free clipping system ensures clean, straightforward
wall installation.
features:
Sculptural 3D peak profile with realistic
digitally printed woodgrain or stone finishes

Digitally printed with safe,
water-based UV-cured ink without reducing acoustic absorption

Rear air gap

Glue-free
mechanical clipping system allows fast, clean, and mess-free installation
Lightweight alternative to real timber battens or heavy stone fluting

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60% to 80% recycled
PET

Modular 300mm
width sections available in 2400mm and 2700mm lengths

Moisture and mould resistant
(ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating: 0)

install: Check wall substrate is plumb, flat, and dry

Inspect printed grain or
pattern orientation across all lanes prior to mounting

Fix horizontal
mounting clips or channel track to framing studs at 300mm vertical centres

Snap the printed folded Peak lanes onto mounting clips firmly without
adhesive

Align adjacent panels to ensure unbroken woodgrain or stone
continuity along joints

Trim bottom or top ends carefully using a
fine-toothed saw on the offcut side
selection_checklist:
Select print
finish from Acoustic Timber woodgrains or Surface Finishes stone palettes
Confirm wall height to choose 2400mm or 2700mm lengths

Calculate wall width
in 300mm increments (3 lanes per pack)

Confirm Peak ridge profile suitability
for design aesthetic

Verify substrate framing supports mechanical clip
mounting
limitations:
Indoor use only;
avoid wet areas or direct water exposure

Requires mechanical clip
installation; do not glue directly flat to wall

Handle carefully with clean
gloves to prevent scuffing the printed surface during install

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle Peak combines a 3D folded peak batten profile with
high-definition digital UV printing of premium timber grains and stone textures
on 12mm Cube polyester felt. Installed via a mechanical clipping system that
preserves an acoustic rear air gap, it delivers high sound absorption (NRC 0.80)
while replicating heavy timber or stone without the weight or fire risks.
Certified Group 1 fire compliant and carbon neutral with over 60% recycled PET,
it provides a warm architectural wall finish for commercial, education, and
hospitality interiors.
